collection_scope: Public English-language reviews returned for the India Google Play listing.
limitations: Official India Google Play listing checked live on 2026-10-13: 4.3 stars, 1.15L reviews (rounded). AppBrain third-party Android tracker showed 12.20.0 and 4.32/114,644 on 2026-10-12; Apple iOS listing shows 10.50.0 and 4.7/60k, separate platform version sequences. privacy_minimization: Dataset excludes public display names, profile-image URLs, review IDs, thumbs-up counts, raw developer-response text, and reply timestamps. It retains review text, star score, timestamp, version, and a boolean reply-presence field because those fields support the analysis.

Exact rating denominator was not exposed; 115,000 is only a rough arithmetic representative of the rounded display.
